desc: Select the Kruskal DSU greedy approach with per-component A/B counts and delta formula.

Implement the final Python program using the Kruskal DSU greedy: read input, count A/B occurrences per vertex, sort edges by weight, maintain per-component A/B counts, on each successful union compute delta = min(a1+a2, b1+b2) - min(a1,b1) - min(a2,b2), add w*delta to the answer, and print the answer; verify on samples and edge cases.
